ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High-contrast distribution with approximately 85-90% low-intensity black pixels and 10-15% high-intensity white pixels.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Primary dark mass pigmentation across 90% of the fluke surface. High-contrast white contiguous geometric blobs are concentrated at the distal tips of both the left and right lobes, with smaller focal spots scattered along the upper trailing edge boundary.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped depression with a central pixel angle of approximately 100 degrees and a vertical bounding-box depth equivalent to approximately 1/6th of the total visible fluke height.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Highly irregular serration profile along the entire trailing edge. Variation consists of jagged peaks and valleys with pixel-amplitudes ranging from 5 to 20 pixels relative to the mean edge line.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: The trailing edge follows a concave sweep from the central notch to the distal tips. The lateral margins exhibit a sharp convex curve tapering upward towards the outer points.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: High-density clusters of roughly circular white pixel groups (rosettes) are localized at the extreme lateral tips of both lobes. Smaller, less dense clusters are visible along the mid-section of the trailing edge.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Short, unaligned horizontal and diagonal linear white disruptions are present on the medial region of the left lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive high-contrast scarring and pigmentation loss localized at the extreme distal tips and along the irregular trailing edge serrations.
